posts.title: How web browsers work
posts.description: A few years ago, I started going down the rabbithole of browser engines . I wanted to write one, so I started looking for resources. None were as detailed as I had hoped. posts.title: Finding vulnerabilities in a cleaning robot
posts.description: I’ve had a round cleaning robot of a certain brand for quite some time now. The other day I noticed a suspicious micro USB port on the bottom. So I had to do some poking around. posts.title: Creating a game in assembly
posts.description: Coding in assembly imposes some challenges and difficulties that make it fun , the same way a puzzle is fun. I recently decided to create a game in assembly. Not for the final result, but for the fun of writing assembly. This is the first post about the project. I might not “finish” it, but again, it’s not the goal of the project anyway.
